prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset: Historyline 1914–1918 elite-infantry owner-neutral unit portrait for CP_eliteInf and EC_eliteInf.
Image 1 is the original repository eliteInfantry.png composition and sepia colour reference. Image 2 is the existing newly painted infantry illustration, STYLE ONLY.
Paint a high resolution version of Image 1 in the established restrained historical strategy illustration style. Target about 90% visual resemblance after Lanczos3 downsampling to 210x188: retain the broad silhouettes, exact camera, object placement and ochre/sepia values. This is reference-guided art, not a new composition.
Scene: World War I machine-gun team low in a grassy field. Long thin machine-gun barrel points horizontally LEFT from the lower-left-middle, ending near x10%,y66%. Dark gun receiver at x45%,y66%, tripod legs spreading down towards bottom-left and bottom-centre. Main helmet/cap-wearing gunner kneels/crouches on RIGHT, head at x68%,y57%, bent arms working gun at centre, torso and bent knees fill lower-right. Small partially occluded assistant immediately behind/left of receiver at x43%,y61%. Gun and crew occupy bottom half. Upper half is broad quiet pale ochre sky, broken pale cream clouds at upper left/centre. Low quiet distant field horizon, rough brown grass at bottom. Follow Image 1's proportions, occlusions, muted palette, poses and leftward orientation. No extra squad, explosions, flags or new scenery.
Style: continuous digital painting with broad connected contours, carefully painted gunmetal, wool cloth, leather and grass, selective mechanical detail. Natural subdued ochre/khaki/olive-brown highlights and shadows. Match Image2's painted medium but keep Image1's colour/value composition, not Image2's faces or three-soldier layout. Not a photo, vector, pixel enlargement or cartoon.
Fully opaque landscape 105:94 aspect, preferably1680x1504. Full bleed illustration only: omit the old UI frame/bevel, extend natural sky/field to edges. Keep all essential subjects safe inside centred105:94 crop. No baked text, insignia, logos, borders, UI or ownership colour. Output one finished illustration.
cleanup: Unchanged generated PNG retained. Existing Go Lanczos3 exporter only; no pixel retouch, alpha removal, rotation, mirroring or original-pixel compositing.
acceptance: Approximate90% resemblance at reference size is a visual target, not a measured score. Runtime and native-resource correspondence remain open.
